Step one is the backend: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles payment verification, order logging, and product delivery. Step two is the payment layer: NOWPayments connects your wallet addresses to the checkout flow — no KYC required from you or your buyer. Step three is the storefront: Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages serves your store for free with no server management. Step four is testing: complete a real mainnet transaction, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Only after step four passes cleanly should you promote the store. COREMERCH deploys the complete Edge Stack — Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments — in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The infrastructure we will be using in this guide is based on the COREMERCH Sovereign Stacks, which provide a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. By using GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and NOWPayments, we can create a store that is not dependent on any single platform, and therefore, not subject to their restrictions. This infrastructure is perfect for digital creators who have been locked out of conventional payment processing services.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you will need to sign up for a GitHub account if you don't already have one. You will also need to create a new repository for your store, and set up a new Cloudflare Pages project. Additionally, you will need to create a NOWPayments account, which will allow you to accept crypto payments from your customers. Once you have completed these steps, you will be ready to deploy your store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you will need to create a new Cloudflare Workers project, which will handle the payment processing and delivery of your products. You will also need to set up a Supabase project, which will store your order data. Finally, you will need to configure your NOWPayments account to accept payments from your customers. This will involve setting up a new payment method, and configuring your webhook to send notifications to your customers when a payment is received.
The COREMERCH Sovereign Stacks provide a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you will be ready to go live with your store. This involves deploying your Cloudflare Pages project, and configuring your NOWPayments account to accept payments from your customers. To process your first transaction, you will need to send a test payment to your store, and then verify that the payment was received correctly. This will involve checking your NOWPayments account, and verifying that the payment was processed correctly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is live, you will need to scale your infrastructure to handle increased traffic and transaction volume. This will involve upgrading your Cloudflare Pages project to a paid plan, and configuring your Supabase project to handle increased data storage needs. You will also need to monitor your NOWPayments account to ensure that it is processing payments correctly, and make any necessary adjustments to your payment and delivery pipeline to ensure that your store remains operational.
